# Cost-per-use / Cost-per-day Calculator

> Free client-side calculator that shows how much a purchase costs per day and per use.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://cost-per-use.try-dabble.com/
All data stays in the browser (localStorage). No accounts, no server-side storage.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cost-per-use.try-dabble.com/): Add items with name, purchase price, purchase date, and optional times used. View cost/day and cost/use. Edit or delete saved items.
- [Privacy](https://cost-per-use.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy stub
- [Terms](https://cost-per-use.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use stub

## Features

- Cost per day from purchase date to today, or over an expected useful life when one is set
- Cost per use when times-used is provided
- Live preview of cost per day and cost per use while typing
- Saved list with edit, delete and three sort orders (newest, highest per day, name)
- Multi-language UI: Korean (default preference), English, Chinese, Japanese
- Installable PWA with offline shell via service worker
- Local-only persistence
